node.title: What does chdir ?
node.author: pcouderc
node.doctext:
This script fails : #!/usr/bin/perl # # chdir 'core/efl'; `./autogen.sh`; But if I key : cd core/efl ./autogen.sh my configuration is ok. What do I miss ? What is the difference ?

Update: added . in front of /autogen.sh in second code snippet
